definitions.gloss: lingering summer heat; late summer heat
definitions.explanation: the continued hot weather after the traditional end of summer, typically from mid-August through September

examples.japanese: {残暑|ざんしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The lingering summer heat is severe.

examples.japanese: {残暑|ざんしょ}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I send you my regards during the lingering summer heat.

examples.japanese: {残暑|ざんしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}した→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: I got sick because the lingering summer heat continued.

notes:
SEASONAL VOCABULARY:
{残暑|ざんしょ} refers to the hot weather that continues after ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧ (the traditional start of autumn, around August 7-8) through September.

SEASONAL GREETING:
{残暑|ざんしょ}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧ is a formal summer greeting card sent during this period. It replaces {暑中|しょちゅう}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧ (summer greeting) after ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {残暑|ざんしょ}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ - formal summer greeting (after ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧)
- {残暑|ざんしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧ - the lingering heat is severe
- {残暑|ざんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} - during the lingering summer heat (formal letter)

TIME PERIOD:
⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧ (around August 7-8) through ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧ (around September 23)

RELATED WORDS:
- {暑中|しょちゅう} - midsummer heat (before ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧)
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ - intense heat
- ⟦{酷暑|こくしょ}→酷暑：08324_kokusho⟧ - extreme heat
